recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not add redundant FHIR-13208 prose; any further refinements to status/inactive behavior should be handled under the later FHIR-51249/FHIR-42956 issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-13208 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked the CodeSystem concept status guidance to mention the standardized http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#inactive property and to be specific about how inactive is used in HL7 code systems.
initial_application: The inactive concept already existed in the concept-properties CodeSystem before the issue. Commit 9ab4222960fdd822fee328183740919341432c3a, titled "GF#13208 - fix up inactive codes" and carrying svn revision 14640, applied the Jira by adding HL7 usage guidance to the CodeSystem status section.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes the concept-properties CodeSystem. Later vocabulary work kept inactive while refining the surrounding guidance: FHIR-37849 harmonized the resource page table and concept-properties CodeSystem, FHIR-41678 added reserved-code guidance, and FHIR-51249 added current rules for the relationship between status and inactive. FHIR-42956 is related background but remains Resolved - change required and was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-properties.xml defines inactive with boolean dataType, and current source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml lists the ...inactive property, says HL7 uses Active, Deprecated, and Retired statuses, and states that active status is not inactive while retired/inactive statuses are inactive.
